title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(平田宏聡研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Hirata Hiroaki)
keywords: Mechanobiology 2.Molecular and cellular biology 3.Mechanical measurement/manipulation 4.Live imaging 5.Cancer
educationalGoal: Spatiotemporal control of cells underlies structures and functions of our bodies. Our laboratory studies how cellular functions are regulated by intracellular and extracellular mechanical environments. Furthermore, we aim at developing a new medical strategy for the cell function control by mechanical intervention. By conducting these researches, students will learn experimental/analytical skills in cell biology and mechanobiology, and acquire skills for scientific thinking.
advice: Specific research themes will be determined based on students’ interests and discussion with the supervisor. In prior to conducting experiments and analyses, students need to prepare their detailed plans. We will have weekly lab meetings for progress reports and journal club. Logical thinking, which is essential for planning experiments/analyses and deriving conclusion from obtained results in any R&D activities, will be trained by active discussion in lab meetings.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of cell biology, molecular biology and biochemistry is required. Students are encouraged to actively introduce new experimental/analytical methods into their own projects.

activityGoals.body: Ability to accumulate and explain background knowledge required for conducting research
Ability to logically approach issues yet to be revealed
Ability to plan and conduct experiments/analyses, and discuss the results
Ability to describe cellular functions from the aspect of integration of biochemical and mechanical information
Ability to report and present clearly the research achievement

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
